scope: git-tracked kernel/**/*.rs, fixed lexical families and manual owner contracts; no AST/macro/call-graph proof
limitations: Generic heap signals are candidates only, not reviewed individual owners.
Dynamic evidence is separate; global Buddy deltas cannot identify per-owner events.
Platform/cfg reachability is human-reviewed, not inferred from lexical presence.
NVMe/USB host implementations absent in baseline; dormant vendor GPU/Input are not active devices.
Rust source only: no C/assembly parsing, macro expansion, alias analysis or automatic cfg/reachability proof.
Exact invocation content anchors deliberately require review after argument or formatting edits; source line relocation alone does not.
